core_obligations: Reduce to a faithfully flat extension of the base ring (proof lines 4647-4648).
Choose a finite locally free extension in which the target has a presentation by monic polynomials (proof lines 4649-4656).
Replace the ring by that extension and use surjectivity on spectra to exhibit the vanishing locus of the intersection of the quotients as the whole spectrum (proof lines 4657-4667).
Conclude that the intersection ideal is nilpotent and that the module is flat modulo it (proof lines 4668-4676).
Lift flatness through the nilpotent ideal to obtain flatness over the ring (proof lines 4677-4681).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a finite locally free base change (proof lines 4647-4656).
Produce the nilpotent ideal from the presentation (proof lines 4657-4667).
Get flatness modulo the nilpotent ideal and lift it (proof lines 4668-4681).
difficulty_reason: The lemma descends flatness of a module along a finite injective homomorphism of Noetherian rings. The proof first replaces the base ring by a finite locally free extension in which the target acquires an explicit presentation by monic polynomials, which is legitimate because flatness descends along faithfully flat extensions. In that normal form the surjectivity of the induced map on spectra produces finitely many quotients through which the module is flat, the ideals defining them intersect to an ideal whose vanishing locus is the whole spectrum, hence to a nilpotent ideal, and flatness modulo that nilpotent ideal is lifted back to flatness over the ring by the standard lifting result. Each step quotes its input exactly.
